The Skullcrusher Orcs

Connects to: 11.03, 14.00, 16.16.06 and 43.08.

Overview

The Weeper’s daughter arranged for the Skullcrusher orcs, then children, to be cared for in this secluded mountain valley within the Winterjarl’s marche. They live here still and create sturdy and elegant woodwork.
